item.title: Forum Crit Team - Staff Post
item.content:encoded:
You're really going to have to expand on this a lot more before anyone can give you any useful critique on this idea. Remember: you get 400 words in the final four sections to explain this, and you've currently used 24 words.

This doesn't even consider that parts of this feel inconsistent: 'The skip causes instantaneous los of cohesion in most solid material' and "It causes crystalizing of bone if you touch it" are not two things that feel intuitively like they connect and it needs more detail to help us understand your idea. Your post summary mentions D-9876 but there's no mention of who they are or what they have to do with this SCP.

I would highly recommend editing the original post to cover more detail about what the SCP is and what the article is about, using the 'Edit' button under the blue 'Options' button at the bottom right corner of the post.
